description: Predefined physician-review wording for LAI indication and choice R5. The LLM never supplies this text; the app renders the matching branch deterministically from stored posteriors, saved evidence, and missingness. All slots are escaped at render time. No branch initiates, switches, doses, ranks, or recommends a product; no branch substitutes for the separate deterministic DDI report. The stored question, network version, supplied inputs, returned CPT percentages, and network results remain inspectable alongside every branch per FR-35, including branches where no product is presented.
mapping_rule: Render needs_clarification when required input is partial or conflicting (no posteriors reported). Otherwise render indication_not_established when the indication branch is not established (choice is not presented as an option; safety, delivery, and discussion findings still render). Otherwise render indicated_with_choice when a specific product consideration is put forward for review, or indicated_choice_deferred when the indication is present but no specific product is put forward (explicit refusal, current-LAI individualized review, or uncertain preference/exposure). Always append unknown_disclosure and ddi_pointer on success branches. Always evaluate deterministic pointers from saved inputs first.
unknown_disclosure: Inputs recorded as unknown/incomplete: {unknown_fields_or_none}. Unknown is not a negative finding; clarify as clinically indicated.

indicated_with_choice.heading: LAI review (R5): indication present with product consideration for review
indicated_with_choice.body: Recorded inputs: schizophrenia {SchizophreniaConfirmed_state} ({SchizophreniaConfirmed_source}); preference {LAIPreference_state} ({LAIPreference_source}); adherence {AdherenceHistory_state} ({AdherenceHistory_source}); discussion context {DiscussionContext_state} ({DiscussionContext_source}); candidate readiness {CandidateReadiness_state} ({CandidateReadiness_source}); prior NMS {PriorNMSHistory_state} ({PriorNMSHistory_source}); product plan {ProductPlanReviewed_state} ({ProductPlanReviewed_source}); delivery barriers {DeliveryBarriers_state} ({DeliveryBarriers_source}); LAI status {LAITreatmentStatus_state} ({LAITreatmentStatus_source}). Network LAI_Indication_Choice_R5_draft ({network_version}) indication posterior: indicated {p_indicated}%, not established {p_not_established}% (CPT percentages and posteriors are shown separately). Product consideration distribution over 9 Table 7 LAI products plus DeferredChoice (percentages sum to 100): {choice_table}. Safety review: {safety_table}. Delivery review: {delivery_table}. Discussion prompt: {discussion_table}. Review prompt: the indication is present on recorded inputs; the product distribution above is for review only and no product is selected by this output, including not the highest posterior. The physician decides whether to discuss, which candidate to evaluate, and what to initiate under local policy and current product labeling. {unknown_disclosure} {ddi_pointer}
indicated_with_choice.posterior_state: indication indicated with a presented consideration distribution; no state selects treatment

indication_not_established.heading: LAI review (R5): indication not established; no product choice presented
indication_not_established.body: Recorded inputs: schizophrenia {SchizophreniaConfirmed_state} ({SchizophreniaConfirmed_source}); preference {LAIPreference_state} ({LAIPreference_source}); adherence {AdherenceHistory_state} ({AdherenceHistory_source}); discussion context {DiscussionContext_state} ({DiscussionContext_source}); candidate readiness {CandidateReadiness_state} ({CandidateReadiness_source}); prior NMS {PriorNMSHistory_state} ({PriorNMSHistory_source}); product plan {ProductPlanReviewed_state} ({ProductPlanReviewed_source}); delivery barriers {DeliveryBarriers_state} ({DeliveryBarriers_source}); LAI status {LAITreatmentStatus_state} ({LAITreatmentStatus_source}). Network LAI_Indication_Choice_R5_draft ({network_version}) indication posterior: indicated {p_indicated}%, not established {p_not_established}% (CPT percentages and posteriors are shown separately). No product choice is presented because the formal indication is not established on recorded inputs; this is not a recommendation against LAI and not a contraindication. The following review findings remain visible and were rendered without waiting for model output where marked deterministic: safety review {safety_table}; delivery review {delivery_table}; discussion prompt {discussion_table} (routine education about LAIs remains possible). The physician decides next steps under local policy. {unknown_disclosure} {ddi_pointer}
indication_not_established.posterior_state: not_established (choice suppressed at recommendation level; stored posteriors remain inspectable)

indicated_choice_deferred.heading: LAI review (R5): indication present; product choice deferred
indicated_choice_deferred.body: Recorded inputs: schizophrenia {SchizophreniaConfirmed_state} ({SchizophreniaConfirmed_source}); preference {LAIPreference_state} ({LAIPreference_source}); adherence {AdherenceHistory_state} ({AdherenceHistory_source}); discussion context {DiscussionContext_state} ({DiscussionContext_source}); candidate readiness {CandidateReadiness_state} ({CandidateReadiness_source}); prior NMS {PriorNMSHistory_state} ({PriorNMSHistory_source}); product plan {ProductPlanReviewed_state} ({ProductPlanReviewed_source}); delivery barriers {DeliveryBarriers_state} ({DeliveryBarriers_source}); LAI status {LAITreatmentStatus_state} ({LAITreatmentStatus_source}). Network LAI_Indication_Choice_R5_draft ({network_version}) indication posterior: indicated {p_indicated}%, not established {p_not_established}% (CPT percentages and posteriors are shown separately). No specific product is put forward. Reason: {suppression_reason}. The stored consideration distribution (including DeferredChoice) remains inspectable with the run artifacts; it is not presented as an option here. The following review findings remain visible: safety review {safety_table}; delivery review {delivery_table}; discussion prompt {discussion_table}. The physician clarifies the deferred item and decides under local policy. {unknown_disclosure} {ddi_pointer}
indicated_choice_deferred.posterior_state: indication indicated with DeferredChoice (choice deferred at recommendation level; stored posteriors remain inspectable)

needs_clarification.body: No posterior is reported. Required input is missing, partial, or conflicting: {missing_fields}. Complete or reconcile {missing_fields} and start a new run; later questions are stopped until this is resolved. Any already-recorded deterministic pointer below remains visible and does not wait for a model run.
needs_clarification.heading: LAI review (R5): clarification required

deterministic_pointers.otherwise: No deterministic pointer fires; the indication and consideration branches above still require physician review.

pointers.text: CAUTION recorded: prior neuroleptic malignant syndrome is recorded. LAI use in this patient needs individualized caution per STATEMENT-10; this is not an absolute contraindication and not a clearance. Do not await model output.

Respect recorded preference: the patient explicitly declines LAI treatment. Review concerns and alternatives through shared decision-making without forced treatment or automatic discontinuation of current care. The formal indication may still be present on adherence grounds; no product is put forward while refusal stands.

Current LAI treatment is recorded. This question does not choose a new product; review the current treatment individually (response, tolerability, product plan, barriers) rather than initiating a switch from this output.

Delivery review needed: product plan not reviewed and/or access barriers recorded. Review labeling items and address barriers (transport, scheduling, cost/authorization, staffing, space) before any initiation decision. Do not await model output.

Contextual discussion may be considered on the recorded context (oral nonresponse with possible gaps, care transition, early illness or awareness/substance-use concern, or repeated hospitalizations/emergency visits). Context prompts discussion only and is not added to the formal indication.

deterministic_pointers.rule: Rendered directly from saved inputs WITHOUT waiting for any LLM request, inference result, or template posterior. Shown alongside (never replaced by) the posterior branch.
